name: fusion-vqc-v1
note: 8-qubit angle-encoded VQC, CNOT ring. Research backend. Served until 2026-09-12, when the preregistered CheXpert external validation (artifacts/chexpert_external.json, n=4800) put it last of four arms on accuracy (0.4721 vs 0.5273 classical, McNemar p<0.001). Native shot-noise uncertainty + QMBA when selected. See docs/QUANTUM.md.

name: fusion-poe-v1
note: Bayesian product-of-experts. Served backend since 2026-09-12: fair-benchmark accuracy winner internally, and significantly more accurate than the VQC on the preregistered external CheXpert cohort.

calibration.note: The served calibration is safety_classical.npz, loaded by Calibration.load(backend='classical') and verified on 2026-09-12 to match a fresh fit on the current weights exactly. The shared safety.npz still holds the quantum fit (T=0.9057, qhat=0.9144): research harnesses that call Calibration.load() with no backend (audit_all.py, ml/evaluation/benchmark.py) reproduce published tables against it, so it is deliberately left unchanged.
